# Towing.ge — ევაკუატორი თბილისი / Tow Truck in Tbilisi, Georgia

> Towing.ge is a 24/7 tow truck (ევაკუატორი) and roadside-assistance company in Tbilisi, Georgia. It tows all vehicle types (sedans, SUVs, vans, motorcycles), has a crane "spider" tow truck (ობობა ევაკუატორი) for hard-to-reach places, and serves every Tbilisi district and all of Georgia. Typical arrival time within Tbilisi is 20–30 minutes. Call +995 514 90 80 90.

Every page below has a clean Markdown copy (the `.md` links). The full site in one file: https://towing.ge/llms-full.txt

## Contact
- Phone (24/7): +995 514 90 80 90 — also WhatsApp and Viber
- Mobile vulcanization line: +995 511 14 82 85
- Tourist service & group tours: +995 555 52 32 51
- Email: info@towing.ge
- Address: Khizanishvili street (ხიზანიშვილის ქუჩა), Tbilisi 0167, Georgia
- Hours: 24/7, including weekends and holidays
- Service area: all Tbilisi districts (Vake, Saburtalo, Vera, Mtatsminda, Old Tbilisi, Avlabari, Isani, Samgori, Varketili, Chughureti, Didube, Nadzaladevi, Gldani, Dighomi, Temka, Ortachala, Krtsanisi, Avchala, Lilo, Vazisubani, Tskneti, Okrokana) and all of Georgia
- Google Business Profile: https://share.google/x3qlewegYCwtLG5CQ — leave a review: https://g.page/r/CW1gUxKtUO8rECE/review
- Prices: depend on distance, vehicle type and condition; quoted by phone before dispatch

## Tow truck (ევაკუატორი)
- [ევაკუატორი თბილისი — homepage](https://towing.ge/index.html.md): 24/7 tow truck in Tbilisi, all services
- [ევაკუატორი თბილისის ყველა უბანში](https://towing.ge/evakuatori-tbilisi/index.html.md): tow truck in every Tbilisi district, towing types, how to call, FAQ
- [ევაკუატორის გამოძახება](https://towing.ge/evakuatoris-gamodzaxeba/index.html.md): how to call a tow truck — 3 steps, when you need one, safety tips while waiting
- [ობობა ევაკუატორი](https://towing.ge/services/oboba-evakuatori/index.html.md): crane (spider) tow truck for narrow streets, yards, tight parking, vehicles that cannot roll

## Roadside assistance
- [აკუმულატორის შეცვლა გამოძახებით](https://towing.ge/services/akumulatoris-shecvla/index.html.md): battery selection, delivery and installation on site, 24/7
- [ავტომობილის დაქოქვა](https://towing.ge/services/avtomobilis-dakokva/index.html.md): car jump start on site
- [მოძრავი ვულკანიზაცია](https://towing.ge/services/modzravi-vulkanizacia/index.html.md): mobile tyre repair — puncture repair, tyre change, pressure check (sister site: https://vulkanizacia.ge)
- [საბურავის შეცვლა](https://towing.ge/services/saburavis-shecvla/index.html.md): flat tyre change / spare wheel fitting on site
- [მძღოლის სერვისი](https://towing.ge/services/mdzgvolis-servisi/index.html.md): professional driver drives your car to your destination
- Fuel delivery (საწვავის მიწოდება) and car lockout opening (მანქანის გაღება) — described on the homepage

## Other services
- [მილების შედუღება](https://towing.ge/services/milebis-shedugheba/index.html.md): polyethylene PE/HDPE pipe welding D40–D250, pressure sewer installation, trenchless laying
- New and used tyres, Land Rover parts (2008–2025) and auto service, Land Rover dismantling, sewage pumping, pressure pipe cleaning, tourist service and group tours — described on the homepage
